seo.title: Our Villas – Villa AEOLINA
seo.description: Explore the Villa AEOLINA collection in Corfu: ELEA, OLIVA, and NATALIA – three private villas surrounded by olive trees in Episkopiana.

intro.title: The AEOLINA Collection
intro.text: Welcome to Villa AEOLINA – a collection of three elegant villas nestled in a peaceful olive grove in Episkopiana, Corfu. Each villa offers privacy, comfort, and a natural connection to the Mediterranean landscape.

natalia.name: Villa NATALIA
natalia.desc: Our spacious 4-bedroom villa with a private pool, ideal for families or larger groups (up to 8 guests).

oliva.name: Villa OLIVA
oliva.desc: A tranquil 2-bedroom retreat for up to 4 guests, featuring elegant interiors and garden views.

elea.name: Villa ELEA
elea.desc: A sunlit and cozy 2-bedroom villa perfect for couples or small families seeking peaceful relaxation.
